What is Advanced IPL Facial?

IPL uses light energy to stimulate new collagen to form in the skin to fix many skin issues. IPL uses broad-spectrum light with varying wavelengths that penetrate the skin at different depths, allowing it to treat many skin conditions. This treatment is favored by many for managing pigmentation, enlarged pores, wrinkles, acne, etc.

Experience healthier and more radiant complexion with this therapy.
Benefits of Advanced IPL Facial
Not only repairs signs of aging, but helps to prevent future signs as well
Minimal downtime

Immediate result of initial IPL therapy is a brighter skin tone. Maintenance treatments help to keep your skin looking younger and healthy, promote collagen growth, prevent the effects of sun damage, and give the skin a healthy glow
Combines well with other facial treatments, such as chemical peels and infusions. These treatments target the surface layer of skin, while IPL reaches the deeper layers of skin
IPL produces multiple wavelengths of pulsating light, as a result, IPL can treat a range of skin conditions at the same time
Suitable For

Pigmentation
IPL breaks down unwanted pigments in your skin

Dull uneven skin
IPL stimulates collagen growth for smoother, younger looking skin

Acne
IPL kills p.acne bacteria and controls oil and manages scarring and pigmentation

Anti-aging
IPL reduces fine lines and wrinkles, while improving skin elasticity

Reduce pore size
New collagen formation helps to reduce appearance of pore size
How Advanced IPL Facial Works

• IPL treatment uses intense wavelengths of light to heat the skin surface enough to stimulate the skin to naturally regenerate while boosting collagen production. Over time, clients are left with a smoother skin tone, healthier complexion, and less visible sun damage.
  • During the treatment, light energy is applied to your skin in flashes.
  • The light energy converts to heat in the deep layers of your skin, bringing about positive changes for skin rejuvenation.
  • Includes a soothing mask to calm skin after light/heat therapy.
